model.name: FLUX.1 Dev
model.shortDescription: FLUX.1 Dev by Black Forest Labs. High-quality text-to-image and image-to-image with strong prompt adherence, ControlNet, and a top base for LoRA fine-tuning.

inputs.description: A single LoRA or composition model ID. If a composition is provided, the loras and lorasScale arrays will be automatically populated from the composition's concepts. If a LoRA is provided, it will be added to the loras array.
inputs.label: LoRA or Composition Model
inputs.name: modelId

inputs.description: List of one or more LoRA model IDs. If provided, this will override the LoRAs extracted from the composition (when modelId is a composition). If modelId is a LoRA and this is not provided, it will be automatically populated with the modelId.
inputs.label: Flux LoRA
inputs.name: loras

inputs.description: Lower values adhere more closely to the image, while higher values allow for more creative freedom. (Higher values are recommended for this model)
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.name: strength

inputs.description: Control image used to condition the generation (edge / depth / pose / etc., per the selected modality).
inputs.label: Control Image
inputs.name: controlImage

inputs.description: How the control image should be interpreted.
inputs.label: Control Modality
inputs.name: controlModality

inputs.description: How strongly the control image conditions the generation. Higher = output adheres more closely to the control image's structure; lower = the prompt dominates. Recommended range 0.3–0.8. Starting points: canny / depth / tile ~0.7, pose / gray / blur / low-quality ~0.8–0.9. Above 0.9 can become rigid or artifact-prone.
inputs.label: Control Strength
inputs.name: controlStrength

inputs.description: Fraction of diffusion steps (0–1) at which the control image begins influencing the generation. 0 = active from the first step. Strength is how much; Start / End is when.
inputs.label: Control Start
inputs.name: controlStart

inputs.description: Fraction of diffusion steps (0–1) at which the control image stops influencing the generation. 1 = active until the last step. Lowering it (e.g. 0.65) locks composition early then releases so the prompt can refine details ,  useful for pose at high strength.
inputs.label: Control End
inputs.name: controlEnd

inputs.description: The width of the generated images, must be a multiple of 16
inputs.label: Width
inputs.name: width

inputs.description: The height of the generated images, must be a multiple of 16
inputs.label: Height
inputs.name: height

inputs.description: Controls how closely the generated image follows the prompt (ignored for schnell)
inputs.label: Guidance
inputs.name: guidance
